title: Monday Quick Tip
subtitle: Harder than game day
hook: Is your practice easier or harder than your games?
intro: In practice, every throw is on target.
In games, the pressure changes everything.
statement: Kids handle games better when practice asks more of them.
q1: Do you add pressure in practice with live runners and time —
q2: or keep practice easier so kids build confidence?
q3: Where does your team struggle in games?
t1: Both can work. But game day feels easier
t2: when practice was a little harder.
cta: Coaches — how hard is your practice?
ctaLines: Live runners. A clock. Two strikes to start.
ctaPrompt: Share your practice habit below. There are no wrong answers.
caption:
Is your practice easier or harder than your games?
In practice, every throw is on target. In games, the pressure changes everything.
Kids handle games better when practice asks more of them.
Practice harder than games or build confidence first. Every team is different.
How hard is your practice? Share your habit in the comments.
